'''December 2000 Minneapolis tournament (19 December)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota on 19 December 2000. [[Michael Raveling]] won it. It is known from Garrett Larson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1564">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1564/ mirkwood-deadbody-style], DeckTech (garrett "deadbody" larson, 21 December 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-12-21-mirkwood-deadbody-styled1564/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 19 December 2000
* '''Site:''' Mirkwood, Minneapolis, Minnesota
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Michael Raveling]]
